headlines.title: Robotics startup Genesis AI raises $500m backed by Nvidia
Vals: in simulated scenarios, AI models from Anthropic, Google, xAI, DeepSeek, and OpenAI identified civilians, ambulances, and a school as military targets (Katrina Manson/Bloomberg)
Microsoft unveils six AI models spanning coding, cybersecurity, images, and voice, saying MAI Code 2 has 98% of GPT-6.1 Sol's performance at 40% of the price (Ina Fried/Axios)
GPT-6.2 Astra costs $8/1M input and $40/1M output tokens, down 20% from GPT-6 Astra; GPT-6.2 Sol keeps GPT-6.1 Sol's $2/1M input and $10/1M output token pricing (Zac Hall/9to5Mac)
OpenAI debuts GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol in ChatGPT Work, Codex, and API, saying Astra sets records on work and science evals at under a third of GPT-6 Astra's cost (OpenAI)
Docs: Nvidia stopped reporting Singapore unit revenue in 2025 as it accounted for nearly 50% of global revenue; the unit's revenue rose 72% YoY to $104B in 2025 (Financial Times)
Genesis AI Raises $500M At $3.5B Valuation To Bring Its Robots To Factories And Warehouses
Indian chip startup Bharat Semi lands $24M seed round as it eyes global AI sensor market
Google’s Spark AI agent becomes ‘Tasks’ — and now it’s free
Pedestal AI raises $4.7 million to agentify the supply chain
Google makes it easier to use Gemini without training AI on your data
Booking Holdings’ travel startup Vayo starts booking trips with AI agents, even on rival Expedia
Portland startup Fairly raises $22M to pair local caretakers with AI for vacation rentals
Cybersecurity AI startup Corma reaches $1B valuation in about 3 months
Former UW AI researchers Yejin Choi and Carlos Guestrin raise $110M for AI startup Noeri
Apple's System Status page shows an outage affecting iCloud sign-in for "all users", the App Store, and Apple Music; some users report failed iPhone activations (Sarah Perez/TechCrunch)
Anthropic lets apps bill Claude costs to their customers
Google updates Gemini Privacy Hub to extend its retention period for temporary chats and chats with history turned off from 72 hours to around two months (Jagmeet Singh/TechCrunch)
OpenAI for Chile aims to train civil servants and back startups
Early data points to Vulcan’s first stage in launch failure that cost Amazon 40 Leo satellites
Google buys Howie, an AI assistant that books your meetings
Glenn Kelman’s next act: Former Redfin CEO takes on health care with stealthy startup Sojourn
Jensen Huang offers to return as Nvidia CEO if the board asks, CNBC reports
AI models flagged civilians as military targets in tests, Bloomberg reports
